name: Zoptiks
summary:
Put a dinosaur on your desk. Step into a BioDome. Build a rover and test your ideas.

Zoptiks brings wildlife, living worlds and hands-on science into your room.

YOUR SPACE
Arrange floating windows, customize your virtual desk or place supported activities on a real table. Bring 3D models within reach to move, turn and resize them.

LIVING WORLDS
Investigate 60 BioDome destinations, including six prehistoric reconstructions. Record observations, compare study conditions and explore at tabletop scale, in mi
